aiAssistant.name: Nexo
aiAssistant.welcomeDescription: I'm the CRM Pro AI assistant. I can look up information you're allowed to see, explain features and help you organize priorities.
aiAssistant.welcomeLimit: I don't change records or send messages. You stay in control of every action.
aiAssistant.welcomeHint: Pick a suggestion or type your question.
aiAssistant.firstUseQuestion: What would you like to do first?

launcher.discoverySubtitle: Look up clients, check your schedule and ask about the CRM.

composer.placeholder: Ask about clients, schedule or the CRM…
composer.placeholderClients: Ask about your clients or the funnel…
composer.placeholderSettings: Ask how to set up the CRM…
composer.enterHint: Enter sends. Shift+Enter adds a new line.

messages.contextRemoved: The screen context won't be used for the next question.
messages.cancelled: Query cancelled. Your question was kept so you can try again.

errors.network: Couldn't connect to Nexo. Check your connection and try again.
errors.rate_limit: You've made several queries in a short time. Please wait a moment and try again.
errors.session: Your session has expired. Sign in again to continue.
errors.timeout: The query took longer than expected. Please try again.
errors.partial_data: I could answer partially, but some CRM data wasn't available.

context.firstTimeTip: I'm using the {view} context to make suggestions more relevant.

onboarding.postFirstAnswer: You can keep the conversation going without repeating context. You can also use the suggestions below.

returning.morning: Good morning, {name}. What would you like to review?
returning.afternoon: Good afternoon, {name}. How can I help with the CRM?
returning.evening: Good evening, {name}. What would you like to look up?
returning.subtextDashboard: I can summarize priorities, appointments and reminders.
returning.subtextClients: I can check the funnel, explain filters and summarize clients.
returning.subtextClientDetail: I can analyze this client's history and the next points of attention.
returning.subtextEnterprises: I can look up this development's documented information.
returning.subtextReports: I can summarize the selected period's indicators.
returning.subtextSettings: I can guide you through integration and profile settings.

summary.title: Client summary with Nexo
summary.description: A synthesis of the history to prepare your next meeting.
summary.empty: Generate a summary whenever you want to review the history, commitments and next points of attention.
summary.note: Suggestions based only on data recorded in the CRM.
summary.error: Couldn't generate the summary right now.

settings.proactivityDescription: Lets Nexo show discreet contextual notices near the icon, such as pending reminders. Nothing opens automatically and no conversation content is stored.
